title_zh: 室友说梦话被奶奶翻译
title_en: Funny Stories from Life (9/20): Grandma Translates a Roommate's Sleep Talk
note_en: Chinese often uses 都 after a phrase to mean "even": 睡着了都在学习 "studying even in his sleep," and 做梦都在背乘法口诀 "reciting the times tables even in his dreams." English puts "even" before the surprising part, but Chinese puts the surprising situation first and follows it with 都 (or 也) before the verb.
